name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
description:
About This Game

In Prinny Party: Going Overboard!, you and your friends will do whatever it takes to defeat the Supreme Overboard and his Protago-Knights! In practice, it’s quite simple: move around the board, earn experience, acquire more powerful equipment, and turn in quests to stay ahead of the curve. Then, when a boss spawns, work together to take him down!

But friendships don’t last long in Prinny Party—only the player who brings the boss back to spawn gets the credit, so do whatever it takes to be the hero!

Throw, fight, and squabble your way to victory! Whatever you do, just don’t die all at once, or it’ll be game over—for everyone!

Huck, Chuck, Boom!

Pick up and throw your friends, enemies, and frenemies to put things in their place. As always, be careful when handling Prinnies!

Build a Better Tomorrow

By landing on a build space, you can build and upgrade facilities, such as hospitals or armories. Just remember: other players will be able to shop there, too!

It Pays to Pass Some Bills

Triple your damage, move again, or build a cannon capable of wiping out even the most powerful demons. Everything is possible when you pass bills at the Assembly!
short_desc: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!
